ID: `jado-canvas-verify`.

## What it does

Captures each changed surface once per visual group and inspects it at the stage's depth: in explore only broken text, clipping, overlaps and missing content; in refine and ship also hierarchy, alignment, overflow and baselines. Fixes in bounded fix passes and records the inspected capture.

## When to use it

Use it after editing Paper and before delivering a canvas or declaring it ready. The canvas supports observing rendering; keyboard, screen reader and performance checks require other evidence.

## How to use it

Ask for it by name, or invoke it with `/jado-canvas-verify` in Claude Code or `$jado-canvas-verify` in Codex. Provide the document, nodes, expected state and stage. If you are the author, fix in fix passes up to the stage's cap and list what remains; if you are a read-only reviewer, report defects without editing.

## What it delivers

- Actually opened captures of the final revision
- Record of structure, rendering and coverage
- Outcome with any defects or missing evidence

## Example

Verify the final mobile artboard: open the full capture, check long text and cropping and record defective nodes with the observed revision.

## Prerequisites

- Requires observable images of the current canvas, not only an author’s description.
